note: Machine-readable catalogue of import-source capabilities. Each entry of `sources` is the record shape PAP-198 promises: { source, rateLimit, incremental, attachmentExpiry } plus the extra fields PAP-199 and PAP-208 need. Durations are ISO-8601. `null` means the vendor does not publish the value; see `unverified` in the record's `gaps`. Every number carries a `docs` entry with the URL it came from and the date it was read.

pagination.note: Search cannot enumerate more than 10,000 results (400 beyond that). Enumerate with the list endpoints, or shard search by hs_lastmodifieddate windows.

daily limit is account-wide and shared with the customer's other integrations
public OAuth apps are capped at 110 requests per 10 s and cannot buy an increase

sources.name: QuickBooks Online
sources.importPathNote: The API is the only defensible path: report CSVs cannot produce a trial balance that ties (PAP-425).

auth.note: OAuth 2.0 only, no token or key alternative. Refresh tokens rotate and must be persisted on every exchange. A connection is (tokens + realmId), because realmId is in the path.

rateLimit.note: Intuit's limit pages are JavaScript-rendered and could not be captured verbatim on 2026-09-19. The numbers are consistent across the developer hub and help centre but should be confirmed on the first live sandbox run. Batch requests count toward the per-minute limit. Pool workers per realmId with a hard cap of 10.

pagination.note: 1-based offset over a live ledger; always pass MAXRESULTS explicitly (default unverified) and always ORDER BY Id so pages do not shuffle.

sources.incrementalMechanism: GET /cdc?entities=<list>&changedSince=<dateTime>; look-back up to 30 days, max 1000 objects per response; not supported for JournalCode, TimeActivity, TaxAgency, TaxCode, TaxRate
sources.attachmentNote: Binary content is Attachable objects with their own download endpoint, not inline on transactions; URL behaviour unverified.
sources.exportNote: Report and list exports are renderings, not a ledger; per-report options unverified.
gaps: rate-limit numbers are verify-on-first-live-run (JavaScript-rendered docs)
unverified: MAXRESULTS default
CDC excludes JournalCode, TimeActivity, TaxAgency, TaxCode and TaxRate

sandbox companies reset after inactivity
